title: Fighting Myself
lyrics:
[00:30.77]Now sometimes these thoughts in my head speak so loud
[00:34.23]Every little thing that I think about
[00:35.80]Just builds on top of the pain and doubt
[00:37.69]Even though I wanna just let it out
[00:39.12]I try to act like I don't mind it, try to keep my mouth so quiet
[00:43.03]But sittin' there in my silence just seems to amplify it
[00:46.23]When I thought that keepin' this inside would make it better
[00:49.83]I never thought that I would end up ruining it forever
[00:53.30]But every time I think I got everything put back together
[00:56.74]I end up making more regrets, making more regrets
[00:59.94]Falling from grace, I watch it all come apart
[01:03.35]Knowing I could've changed it all from the start
[01:06.94]Fighting myself, I always lose
[01:10.41]Fighting myself, I always lose
[01:13.95]I didn't want you to think I'm worn out so easily
[01:16.60]I wish I'd held it in so you never knew what built up inside of me
[01:20.02]Now I don't know how it overflowed, spilled out unwillingly
[01:23.46]But now everything that I learned to hate came out for you to see
[01:26.97]I don't want you to promise you can change everything and make it better
[01:30.94]'Cause you can bet I'm gonna end up ruining it forever
[01:34.43]And every time you think you got everything put back together
[01:37.84]I end up making more regrets, making more regrets
